caption: The video captures a nighttime outdoor gathering where a long line of costumed dancers stands hand-in-hand behind a burning bonfire. In the foreground, several leaning logs feed bright flickering flames that continually reshape, with thin smoke drifting upward and short spark trails rising at the upper left. The dancers wear matching red traditional costumes with embroidered back panels, fringed skirts and headbands, while one central figure wears a yellow vest crossed by a diagonal strap. The camera pans rightward across the row, so the stationary bonfire and the linked dancers both drift leftward while additional participants come into view at the right edge; the dancers themselves step and sway in place, repeatedly changing foot and leg positions and swinging their linked arms and fringed skirts. Distant tents remain visible in the dark background as the hand-holding chain persists across the scene.
